newsitem.title: USA: Amer Gen Hospitality, Wyndham in pact.
newsitem.headline: Amer Gen Hospitality, Wyndham in pact.

text.p: American General Hospitality Corp and Wyndham Hotel Corp said Thursday they agreed to a hotel franchising strategic alliance.
Financial terms of the alliance were not disclosed.
Under the alliance, Wyndham will have a non-exclusive option to franchaise hotels acquired by American General Hospitality that will be subject to brand conversions.
Wyndham would also invest in American General Hospitality based on a formula that takes into account the franchaise fees Wyndham gets under each franchaise agreement.
Officials from both companies were not immediately available to discuss the formula.
